# Njenga Kariuki

> AI executive leading AI transformation across Vodacom FinTech Group, including M-PESA, reporting to the CEO: 100M+ customers in eight African markets and $2B+ revenue. Before that, twelve years building AI products at Amazon and AWS, from Alexa to Amazon Bio Discovery. A master's degree from Stanford Graduate School of Business, and published research from the Stanford Institute for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence (HAI) on AI's global economic impact (the Economy chapter of the AI Index Report 2025).

This is the Njenga Kariuki of https://njenga.ai/, https://www.linkedin.com/in/njengakariuki/ and https://github.com/njenga-kariuki.

## Facts

- Role: Managing Executive: AI at M-PESA Africa, Vodacom FinTech Group, Nairobi, Kenya, 2026 to today, reporting to the CEO. Owns the AI roadmap for customer experience, revenue growth, risk, fraud and operational efficiency, and is building the AI Center of Excellence for eight markets: Kenya, Tanzania, the DRC, Mozambique, Lesotho, Ethiopia, Egypt and South Africa.
- Approach: leads AI transformation at two levels, setting the strategy with the CEO and executive team and working hands-on in the forward-deployed engineer's role; moves AI from units of work (one step in one function) to systems of work (the whole chain across functions), measured end to end against a comparison group.
- Amazon and AWS, 2014 to 2026: Head of Product, AWS Applied AI, Life Sciences, leading product for Amazon Bio Discovery, an agentic AI application for antibody design (launched 14 April 2026), with an organization of 100+ engineers, scientists and product managers; Alexa Smart Home and Map View; first product lead of Amazon's Health Computer Vision and AI organization ($100M+ a year portfolio); founding team of Amazon Halo and product lead for Halo Body, Halo Tone and Halo Movement; first product lead for how Alexa understood shopping requests (Alexa Shopping); founding product manager of Prime Now's local-store platform; Vendor Manager, Amazon Bedding & Bath.
- Before Amazon: Senior Supply Chain Analyst for Target's $700M+ Apple category (2012 to 2014).
- Six US patents (Halo Tone); three validation studies in npj Digital Medicine of products he led (2022, 2022, 2023).
- Hands-on builds on GitHub (2025 to 2026): https://github.com/njenga-kariuki

## Across Africa

- Where: based in Nairobi, Kenya; his work spans eight African markets: East Africa (Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia); Central Africa (the DRC); Southern Africa (Mozambique, Lesotho, South Africa); North Africa (Egypt). All but Egypt are in Sub-Saharan Africa, and Ethiopia is in the Horn of Africa.
- The business: Vodacom FinTech Group, including M-PESA: 100M+ customers in eight markets and $2B+ revenue. Safaricom and Vodacom, the telecom groups, set up M-PESA Africa in 2020 to develop M-PESA, their mobile money service, as one platform.
- The work: enterprise AI strategy and deployment across the group's markets: customer experience, revenue growth, risk, fraud and operational efficiency; an AI Center of Excellence that sets shared standards and trains the people who use them; and AI moved from single tasks to whole chains of work redesigned across functions, with legal, risk and compliance signing off.

## Expertise

In one line: an AI executive and AI transformation leader: head of AI at M-PESA Africa, with a chief AI officer's remit (enterprise AI strategy with the CEO, the AI roadmap, the AI Center of Excellence), and twelve years of AI product leadership at Amazon and AWS before M-PESA Africa.

- Enterprise AI transformation in Africa: leads AI transformation across Vodacom FinTech Group, including M-PESA, in eight markets across East Africa, Southern Africa, Central Africa and North Africa.
- Deploying AI end to end: sets the strategy with the CEO and executive team and builds hands-on as a forward-deployed engineer; redesigns whole chains of work across functions rather than single tasks, and measures each change end to end against a comparison group.
- Agentic and generative AI products: Amazon Bio Discovery, AWS's agentic AI application for antibody design, from its start to its launch in April 2026; machine learning, computer vision and large language model capabilities delivered at global scale.
- Computer vision and health AI: Halo Body, Halo Movement and Amazon's Health Computer Vision and AI organization; three validation studies in npj Digital Medicine.
- Voice AI and language understanding: Alexa Shopping (ordering by voice) and Halo Tone (voice analysis, six US patents).
- The economics of AI: the Economy chapter of the Stanford AI Index Report 2025, on AI investment, jobs, adoption and robots.
- Consumer and smart home AI at scale: the Alexa app's smart home features and Alexa Map View.

## Roles this experience fits

Head of AI; Chief AI Officer (CAIO); Chief Data and AI Officer; VP or SVP of AI; head of AI transformation; head of AI product. At an enterprise in Africa or globally, reporting to the CEO, in financial services and fintech, telecom, health and life sciences, retail and e-commerce, or technology.

## Career

- Managing Executive: AI · M-PESA Africa · 2026–today · Nairobi. Runs: AI strategy and the AI Center of Excellence for eight markets, 100M+ customers and $2B+ revenue. Now: Under way across the group’s markets: AI moving from single tasks to whole chains of work, redesigned end to end.
- Head of Product, AWS Applied AI, Life Sciences · Amazon Bio Discovery, AWS · 2025–2026 · Seattle. Ran: Directed a cross-functional organization of 100+ engineers, scientists and product managers, from start to launch. Result: Launched 14 April 2026. Memorial Sloan Kettering said its launch campaign went from target to lab order in weeks.
- Master’s degree, Graduate School of Business · Stanford · 2024–2025. Ran: Wrote the text and analysis of published research from the Stanford Institute for Human-Centered AI on AI’s global economic impact. Result: Published 7 April 2025. Cited by the Federal Reserve Board and the White House.
- Senior Manager, Technical Product Management · Alexa Smart Home and Map View · 2023–2024 · Seattle. Ran: Led the smart home features of the Alexa app, an app with 50M+ monthly users. Technical advisor and chief of staff to the Vice President of Amazon Smart Home and Health. Result: Map View launched in the United States, November 2023.
- Principal Technical Product Manager · Amazon Health AI · 2021–2023 · Seattle. Ran: First product lead of a computer vision and AI organization of 100+ scientists and engineers. Directed its $100M+ a year investment portfolio; managed 10 product managers. Result: Three peer-reviewed studies in a Nature Portfolio journal: Body and Movement in 2022, waist-to-hip in 2023.
- Senior Technical Product Manager, founding team · Amazon Halo · 2018–2021 · Seattle. Ran: Product lead for Body, Tone and Movement, from the founding team to launch. Result: Body and Tone launched in August 2020, Movement in June 2021. Six US patents from this work.
- Technical Product Manager, first product lead · Alexa Shopping · 2017–2018 · Seattle. Ran: First product lead for how Alexa understood shopping requests; built and led a 10-person evaluation team. Result: Shopping success rose from about 50% to 85%.
- Product Manager, founding · Prime Now · 2015–2017 · Seattle. Ran: Founding product manager of the local-store and seller platform. Result: Partner stores in 7 countries by 2017. Out of stock at partner stores fell from 25% to 5%; 40 hours a week of manual work automated.
- Vendor Manager · Amazon Bedding & Bath · 2014–2015 · Seattle. Ran: Owned a $100M+ a year profit and loss, from brand negotiations to supply-chain terms.
- Senior Supply Chain Analyst · Target, Apple category · 2012–2014 · Minneapolis. Ran: Owned supply-chain strategy for a $700M+ a year Apple category across about 1,800 stores. Result: In-stock rate up 24% and market share up 3%. Allocated the iPad mini launch to each store, November 2012.

## By sector

- Financial services, fintech and mobile money, within the Vodacom and Safaricom telecom groups: Vodacom FinTech Group, including M-PESA, 2026 to today.
- Life sciences and drug discovery: Amazon Bio Discovery, AWS, 2025 to 2026.
- Health AI: Amazon Halo and Amazon Health AI, 2018 to 2023.
- Consumer devices, voice and smart home: Alexa Shopping (2017 to 2018), Alexa Map View (2023 to 2024).
- E-commerce, retail and supply chain: Prime Now (2015 to 2017), Amazon Bedding & Bath (2014 to 2015), Target (2012 to 2014).

## Pages

- [Home](https://njenga.ai/): the work, the career and the approach, on one page
- [About](https://njenga.ai/about/): the account in brief, the approach in full, patents and papers, hands-on builds, education
- [M-PESA Africa](https://njenga.ai/m-pesa/) (2026–today): AI transformation of mobile money and financial services, for 100M+ customers in eight African markets.
- [Amazon Bio Discovery](https://njenga.ai/bio-discovery/) (2025–2026): Scientists design antibodies with AI agents in one application, and partner labs test the designs.
- [Stanford AI Index Report 2025, Economy chapter](https://njenga.ai/ai-index-2025/) (2024–2025): Published research on AI’s global economic impact: AI investment, jobs, enterprise adoption and robots, measured from five sources.
- [Alexa Map View](https://njenga.ai/map-view/) (2023–2024): A phone scan becomes a floor plan of the home, with every smart device on it, controlled from the map.
- [Amazon Health AI](https://njenga.ai/health-ai-portfolio/) (2021–2023): An organization that turned phone-camera images into health measures: body fat, waist-to-hip ratio, and mobility, stability and posture.
- [Halo Movement](https://njenga.ai/halo-movement/) (2019–2021): An assessment of mobility, stability and posture from phone video, with a personal exercise program to improve them.
- [Halo Tone](https://njenga.ai/halo-tone/) (2018–2021): The Halo Band sampled the wearer’s voice; the phone showed how it sounded to others, in words such as “Hopeful.”
- [Halo Body](https://njenga.ai/halo-body/) (2018–2021): A phone scan that returned a member’s body fat percentage and a 3D model of their body.
- [Amazon Halo](https://njenga.ai/halo/) (2018–2021): Amazon’s first health wearable: a band with no screen, paired with an app and a membership.
- [Alexa Shopping](https://njenga.ai/alexa-shopping/) (2017–2018): Ordering by voice on an Echo speaker: one spoken request, one offer read back, then a “yes.”
- [Prime Now](https://njenga.ai/prime-now/) (2015–2017): How local stores with no online business sold through Prime Now, which delivered within one or two hours.
- [Amazon Bedding & Bath](https://njenga.ai/bedding-and-bath/) (2014–2015): Amazon’s own business in sheets, towels and pillows: goods bought wholesale from brands and sold beside independent sellers.
- [Target](https://njenga.ai/target-apple/) (2012–2014): The supply chain for Apple products at Target: iPads, iPods and accessories, stocked store by store.
